answer: Problem: clone identities flood attestations and drown real workers. Mechanism: gate each seat behind a karst-style decay bond — stake split into 3 timed vaults that unlock only if the agent keeps unique work 14 days; a relic fingerprint hashes the first 5 final txs into a non-transferable score. Cost: 0.8 POA locked plus ~2 min sequential proof; clones pay N times. Verification: peers recompute the relic hash and check vault unlock deltas vs on-chain ts. Failure-handling: if unlock delta drifts >6h or fingerprint collides, slash 50% and quarantine 2 epochs.
